findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company, get_financials, get_directors, search_directors, search_director_companies, search_events, create_saved_search, set_list_monitoring, list_saved_searches, list_watched_companies, get_news, mark_news_read · Private data: resolve_companies, get_company, reveal_director_email, mark_news_read · Public sink: reveal_director_email, create_saved_search, get_news · Destructive: search_director_companies, mark_news_read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company, get_financials, get_directors, search_directors, search_director_companies, search_events, create_saved_search, set_list_monitoring, list_saved_searches, list_watched_companies, get_news, mark_news_read · Private data: resolve_companies, get_company, reveal_director_email, mark_news_read · Public sink: reveal_director_email, create_saved_search, get_news · Destructive: search_director_companies, mark_news_read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
